limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Mail absence was observed for 3 seconds after each controlled event once the Mailpit queue had settled, paired with positive deliveries through the same worker; this bounds the lab, not an arbitrary relay.

Filing an attachment, the Administrator lead-time procedure, and Document Versions were not performed; their guides (DOC-017, DOC-021) are unpublished and both articles stay in review until they pass.
The morning rounds were queued by the reviewer rather than waiting for the hourly cron; the worker served them with its real clock and rules.
